 The Ministry of Health has requested Shopee and Lazada to remove the Dáng Sen weight loss product.
 The Dáng Sen product, advertised as a weight-loss aid on Shopee and Lazada, has not been granted a product registration certificate. The Ministry of Health has ordered the two e-commerce platforms to cease sales and remove related information.
 Báo Tuổi Trẻ • 12/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 The Food Safety Department has ordered the removal of the dietary supplement product "Dáng sen" (Lotus Shape) from sales platforms - Photo: Provided by the Food Safety Department.
 On November 12th, the Food Safety Department ( Ministry of Health ) issued six official documents requesting action against advertising and sales information related to Dáng Sen food products.
 Through post-inspection, the agency discovered that this product was being advertised and sold on Facebook and two e-commerce platforms, Shopee and Lazada, without having received the product registration certificate. Specifically, on Shopee and Lazada, Dáng Sen was advertised as having weight-loss benefits.
 The request is for the two e-commerce platforms to remove the product. 
 The Food Safety Department has requested Shopee Vietnam Co., Ltd. and Lazada Vietnam E-commerce Co., Ltd. to urgently cease trading and remove information about Dang Sen food products from their platforms, and to submit a written report to the department.
 You may also like In addition, the two businesses must review their functional food business activities on the platform, ensuring that they only sell products that have been granted product registration certificates or have been published on the Food Safety Data Information System as prescribed.
 The Department also requested the Department of E-commerce and Digital Economy (Ministry of Industry and Trade) to notify Shopee, Lazada, and the stores on these two platforms about ceasing business, removing information about the Dáng Sen product, and taking appropriate legal action.
 Regarding product advertisements on Facebook, the Food Safety Department requests the Department of Broadcasting, Television and Electronic Information (Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism) to cooperate in removing and handling any violations detected.
 Inspect production and distribution facilities in the two locations. 
 According to information from the Food Safety Department, Dáng Sen food products are manufactured by Thai Hung Import-Export Trading Investment Joint Stock Company, located in Ben Hiep village, Minh Tho commune, Hung Yen province. The product is distributed by Nam Y Duong Co., Ltd., located at 13H1 Tran Kim Xuyen Street, Yen Hoa ward, Hanoi.
 The Food Safety Department requests the Hung Yen Provincial Food Safety and Hygiene Sub-Department to urgently verify and inspect the production, business, and advertising activities of Dang Sen food products at Thai Hung Company.
 You may also like In Hanoi, the City's Food Safety and Hygiene Department was requested to inspect the business and advertising activities of Nam Y Duong Company.
 The Department requested that the two localities strictly handle any violations they discover and report the results to the Department before November 30, 2026.
